breakdown.description: The wall is labeled adiabatic (zero heat flux) but a fixed temperature boundary condition is simultaneously imposed on the same surface.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradiction of having an adiabatic (insulated, dT/dx=0) condition and a fixed temperature condition (T(0)=350K) on the same surface (x=0). It resolved this by creating a physically consistent problem, applying the fixed temperature to one boundary (x=0) and the insulated condition to the other boundary (x=L). This matches the primary resolution path suggested by the ground truth.
